name: Perfect Son-In-Law: Hidden S-Rank
source: She needs you to play her boyfriend. You’re more than capable of the role. Step into the shoes of a secretly overpowered awakener navigating high society, dangerous expectations, and a fake relationship that slowly turns real in this story-driven NSFW visual novel.
